source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: tabs.move rejects moving the primary mail tab and positions other tabs after it when index zero is requested. It calculates insertion per target window, using -1 for the end and clamping positive overshoots. Rightward same-window moves pass insertionPoint + 1 because tabmail removes the source before decrementing the target. getTabWindow obtains the tab’s owning global without requiring an active browser. The checked pre-validation is not a transaction guarantee. Cross-window ID continuity is a separate, unasserted follow-up in this phase; no runtime test ran.
title: Tab moves keep the primary mail tab first and compensate for removal indices
